_comment: High / critical advisories the dependency gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) accepts, each for a stated reason, until it is fixable or its review date. Only exact advisory ids; no package-wide or severity-wide exceptions.

advisories.path: @solana/wallet-adapter-react > @solana-mobile/wallet-adapter-mobile > react-native (peer dependency, installed automatically by npm) > @react-native/community-cli-plugin > metro > metro-file-map > micromatch > braces; dev: shadcn > fast-glob > micromatch > braces; eslint-config-next > @next/eslint-plugin-next > fast-glob > micromatch > braces
advisories.impact: Stack exhaustion when expanding a deeply nested brace pattern. braces only expands glob patterns for build tools (React Native's bundler metro, the shadcn CLI, the ESLint plugin), from the project's own configuration; none of it is in the Next.js output (no braces, micromatch or metro in .next, checked 2026-10-10), so no request input reaches it.
advisories.reason: No fixed release exists: 3.0.3 is the latest braces (registry, 2026-10-10) and the advisory covers <=3.0.3.
advisories.removeWhen: A braces release outside the advisory's range exists (then: npm update braces), or no dependency pulls braces in.

advisories.impact: Buffer overflow in toBigIntLE(). It is in the server bundle: spl-token's layouts read u64 fields with it, from fixed-size slices of account and instruction data. On the machine that ran the 2026-10-10 checks its native addon was not built and the pure-JavaScript fallback ran ('bigint: Failed to load bindings'); whether the addon is built on Vercel is not verified.
advisories.reason: No fixed release exists: 1.1.5 is the latest bigint-buffer. npm's only suggested fix is @solana/spl-token@0.1.8, a major downgrade to a release without the standalone instruction builders and decoder Presign imports (decodeInstruction, createTransferCheckedInstruction, createInitializeAccount3Instruction, createSetAuthorityInstruction, …).
advisories.removeWhen: @solana/buffer-layout-utils or @solana/spl-token stop depending on bigint-buffer, or a fixed bigint-buffer is released.
